name: Matrix Concepts Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年公司通过子公司 Matrix Concepts (Southern) Sdn Bhd 签订买卖协议，拟以 RM169,313,523.00 收购位于 Johor 州 Kulai 县 Senai 区 Tempat Sengkang 的 57 幅农业空地，总面积约 174.7749 公顷。此外，公司就长期激励计划（LTIP，包含 ESOS 和 SGP）及 recurrent related party transactions 的股东授权向股东发出通函，并派发多次单层中期股息。
overview_en: This year, via its wholly-owned subsidiary Matrix Concepts (Southern) Sdn Bhd, the Company entered into sale and purchase agreements to acquire 57 parcels of vacant agriculture land in Tempat Sengkang, Mukim Senai, Daerah Kulai, Johor, measuring approximately 174.7749 hectares in total, for an aggregate cash consideration of RM169,313,523.00.

segments.name: 物业发展与建设
segments.note: 今年公司通过子公司签订协议，拟收购位于 Johor Kulai 的农业空地，用于未来发展。
segments.note_en: This year, via its subsidiary, the Company entered into agreements to acquire vacant agriculture land in Kulai, Johor, for future development.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司就上述拟议收购发布补充资料及澄清说明。
actions.text_en: The Company issued additional information and clarifications in respect of the proposed acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Matrix Concepts (Southern) Sdn Bhd 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日与多名卖方签订买卖协议，拟以现金 RM169,313,523.00 收购位于 Johor 州 Kulai 县 Senai 区 Tempat Sengkang 的 57 幅农业空地，总面积约 174.7749 公顷。
actions.text_en: On 27 October 2026, Matrix Concepts (Southern) Sdn Bhd entered into sale and purchase agreements with various vendors to acquire 57 parcels of vacant agriculture land in Tempat Sengkang, Mukim Senai, Daerah Kulai, Johor, measuring approximately 174.7749 hectar…

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年集团层面涉及长期激励计划、股东授权更新及股息派发等事项。
segments.note_en: At the group level, the year involved a long-term incentive plan, renewal of shareholders' mandates and dividend payments.

actions.title: MATRIX - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 派发单层第一次中期股息每股 1.40 sen。
actions.text_en: Declared a single-tier first interim dividend of 1.40 sen per ordinary share.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO:- PART A-PROPOSED RENEWAL OF SHAREHOLDERS' MANDATE AND PROPOSED NEW SHAREHOLDERS' MANDATE FOR RECURR
actions.text: 向股东发出通函，内容涉及更新及新增 recurrent related party transactions 的股东授权，以及设立长期激励计划（LTIP，包含 ESOS 和 SGP），最多占已发行股份总数的 10%。
actions.text_en: Issued a circular to shareholders on the proposed renewal and new shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions, and the proposed establishment of a long-term incentive plan (LTIP, comprising ESOS and SGP) of up to 10% of the total number of i…

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司拟在应届股东周年大会上寻求股东批准更新及新增 recurrent related party transactions 的股东授权。
actions.text_en: The Company intends to seek shareholders' approval at the forthcoming AGM for the proposed renewal and new shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions.

actions.title: MATRIX - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 派发单层第四次中期股息每股 1.25 sen。
actions.text_en: Declared a single-tier fourth interim dividend of 1.25 sen per ordinary share.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接子公司 Horizon L&L (Sel) Sdn Bhd 在正常业务过程中与 Pembinaan Karisma Perwira Sdn Bhd 及 Shafikzaman & Partners Sdn Bhd 进行 recurrent related party transaction。
actions.text_en: Indirect subsidiary Horizon L&L (Sel) Sdn Bhd entered into a recurrent related party transaction with Pembinaan Karisma Perwira Sdn Bhd and Shafikzaman & Partners Sdn Bhd in the ordinary course of business.

actions.title: MATRIX - Notice of Book Closure
actions.text: 派发单层第三次中期股息每股 1.35 sen。
actions.text_en: Declared a single-tier third interim dividend of 1.35 sen per ordinary share.

actions.text_en: Indirect subsidiary Horizon L&L (Sel) Sdn Bhd entered into a recurrent related party transaction with Pembinaan Karisma Perwira Sdn Bhd and Shafikzaman & Partners Sdn Bhd in the ordinary course of business.
